$description: Where prose stands past the budget of decision 0017 with a reason (req-project-concise). tools/check-prose.mjs requires every unit to fit — a gate header in 12 lines plus one per numbered point, a task position in 12 lines closed and 20 open — and this file is the whole of what is excused from that. An entry holds the exact line count, so an excuse cannot stretch with the text; it is red when the unit fits again, red when the unit is gone, and red when it carries no reason.
$oversize: An entry is a position that is really several positions, written as one because the work closed on one day, and the way to remove it is to split the position, not to shorten it — which is why a reason says what the split would be. The list is empty since 2026-09-16, when the closed positions left the plan; it stays here so the next oversize has a home and a shape.
